title: Thirty-one Winters of Figures
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：condition　|　正文 407 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 condition 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My uncle has kept weather records for thirty-one years: the same two readings, at the same two hours, every single day. His house stands high on the north side of the valley, where the road is blocked for four months a year. He checks the ① conditions at six each morning, writes four figures down and says nothing until somebody asks.

The habit began badly. In the winter of 1989 he ignored his own numbers and set out across the pass, and the fog came down in eleven minutes. He spent the night under a rock and came home with frost in his boots. Three fingers were in poor ② condition by March, and two never fully recovered. That taught him to read his own figures properly.

Farmers from three villages telephone him now. What are the ③ conditions on the pass, they ask, and will it hold until Tuesday? He answers with one word. Conditions change faster than advice, which is why he never gives any. Not prophecy, he insists — arithmetic. Thirty-one winters is a poor sample by the standard of science, but it is the entire working life of the man they are asking.

I once asked him to lend me the notebooks for a school project. He agreed ④ on condition that I copied nothing and returned them within nine days. I was in no ⑤ condition to argue, so I read ten winters in a fortnight and learned two things: the springs have shifted about eleven days earlier, and the dry spells between rains now run longer than any old saying allows.

⑥ Some conditions of that promise were unusual — no photographs, nothing copied from the last seven years — and every one of them was written down first. The single ⑦ condition of joining his little group of recorders, he told me once, is keeping every day for a year without one invented figure. Every condition of that promise, he added, should be written down before it is believed. Climate, people say, is what you expect and weather is what you get; after ten winters of figures I would add a third thing — memory written down, quietly ⑧ conditioning you to notice when the pattern shifts. Nobody in the valley argues with him now, and though the frost arrives later than it used to, the old road is still in poor ⑨ condition every March. Every generation inherits different ⑩ conditions, and not one of them gets to choose.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 状况；状态（多指物品、身体）
B. n. 条件；前提（必须满足的要求）
D. n. （天气、道路的）情况；状况（常用复数 conditions）
E. n. 条款；规定（常用复数 conditions）
F. v. 使习惯于；使适应（condition sb to do）
G. 固定搭配：on condition that 条件是……
H. 固定搭配：in no condition to do 不宜／无法做某事

items.q: He checks the conditions at six
Three fingers were in poor condition
What are the conditions on the pass
He agreed on condition that I copied nothing
I was in no condition to argue
Some conditions of that promise were unusual
The single condition of joining his little group
the old road is still in poor condition

answers.why: check the conditions 指查看天气状况，与全文记录天气的习惯一致，常用复数。
手指处于糟糕状态，指身体的受损程度，取“健康状态”。
the conditions on the pass 指山路上的天气／通行状况，仍用复数。
on condition that＋从句，意为“条件是……”，借出笔记本所附的条件。
in no condition to do 意为“没有余地／不宜做某事”，此处指作者根本无法讨价还价。
conditions of the promise 指约定的“条款、规定”，后文紧接着列举具体内容。
加入记录小组的唯一“条件”是一天不落地记满一年，是必须满足的前提。
condition sb to do 是动词用法，意为“使习惯于、使变得敏感”，此处指文字记忆让人察觉规律的变化。
in poor condition 描述道路（物品）的状态，取名词“状况”。
每一代人继承的 conditions 指所处的环境与气候状况，可用复数。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 他每天早上六点记录天气情况。（conditions）
那年冬天，他的三根手指状况很差。（in poor condition）
他同意借给我，条件是不能复印任何内容。（on condition that）
我根本没有争辩的余地。（in no condition to）
保留工具的一个条件是坚持一整年的记录。（condition of）
三十年后，那条老路的状况依然很差。（in poor condition）
answers: He records the weather conditions at six every morning.
That winter three of his fingers were in poor condition.
He agreed to lend them to me on condition that I copied nothing.
I was in no condition to argue at all.
One condition of keeping the notebooks is recording for a whole year.
Thirty years later, the old road is still in poor condition.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 condition 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: My uncle has recorded the weather conditions twice a day for thirty-one years.
In 1989 he ignored his own figures, and three fingers were in poor condition by March.
Now farmers telephone him to ask what the conditions on the pass will do until Tuesday.
He lent me the notebooks on condition that I copied nothing, and I was in no condition to argue.
The single condition of joining his small group of recorders is keeping every day for a year.
Written memory quietly conditions you to notice when the pattern shifts, even when the road stays in poor condition.
